intent: Choose for stated sufficiency, assign price/spending/balance roles, enter actual yuan amounts and track request/reason/final promise without treating a promise as completed repayment.
picturePurpose: Original paired blue/smaller and coral/larger notebooks make choices tangible. Exact prices and adequacy come only from code/source cards, never pixel size or generated counts. No image answer marks.

workshop.title: 钱花在哪，最后答应哪天
workshop.instruction: 选符合需要的笔记本，自己算金额，再把延期请求与最后承诺分开。

items.label: 按她的需要选，不凭大小选

items.label: 请求、原因、最后承诺分三步
items.prompt: Put the request, reason and final promise in their dialogue order.
items.answer: Request Friday → need on Thursday → final promise Wednesday.
items.reason: 先提出从周三推到周五，Mei说明周四要用，Ben才回到原先答应的周三。排的是对话三步，不是把星期按日历先后排序。
items.hint: 这是对话顺序：先请求周五还，再说明周四要用，最后答应周三还。不要按星期排序。
items.material:
Ben: I borrowed ten yuan from you. Could I return it on Friday instead of Wednesday?
Mei: I need it for the class collection on Thursday.
Ben: Then I will return it tomorrow, Wednesday, as promised. Thank you for reminding me.

The final Wednesday promise is not a report that repayment has already happened. No calendar date is given.

transfer.stem: Which plan meets the pencil-case need, gives the purchase balance and keeps the final repayment promise?
transfer.passage:
NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Tao: I have twenty-five yuan. This small case is six yuan, but it cannot hold all my pencils.
Rae: The nine-yuan case can hold them all. The fourteen-yuan case is larger, but you do not need that extra space.
Tao: I will buy the nine-yuan case and keep the rest.
Rae: You also borrowed six yuan from me and promised to return it on Friday.
Tao: Could I return it on Sunday instead?
Rae: I need it on Saturday.
Tao: Then I will return your six yuan on Friday as promised.
For the purchase balance, subtract only the case price from twenty-five yuan; the loan repayment is a separate promise. These are plans, not completed payments. Read this as preparation, not a listening score.

steps.text: 周日只是延期请求；Rae周六需要，Tao最后仍答应周五还六元。
